title: rust-analyzer cannot work against lane checkouts: pod-built Linux target/ breaks host RA build data
wanted_capability: The lsp.* rust semantic tier (rename/hover/references/assist) needs rust-analyzer to function where agents work, and agents work in lanes. Today RA on macOS pointed at a lane checkout reads a pod-built Linux target/ (proc-macro .so ELF files it cannot load) and its own cargo check children route back into the Linux pod via the $PWD shim, so build data never matches the host. Need one of: (a) RA spawn config (rust-analyzer.toml / initializationOptions) that redirects cargo.targetDir + check.buildScripts to a host-only target dir with a shim bypass (overrideCommand), (b) a documented pod-side RA remote-LSP path, or (c) explicit guidance that rust lsp.* is unsupported in lanes. Blocks live lane validation of the rust isolate semantic tier (design/refactor-tools/rust/rust-isolate-surface.md section 3.3).
missing_primitive: an LSP spawn configuration for lane checkouts that gives rust-analyzer host-platform build data (target-dir override + shim-bypassing cargo for build scripts/proc macros), or a documented pod-side RA story
fallback_used: Run lsp.* against non-lane checkouts (main repo) with a long wait_ready_ms budget, or against small fixtures; live-validate rust semantic-tier work outside lanes until this is designed.
evidence: control fixture /tmp/ra-mini: lsp.rename applied lsp_verified (binding healthy)
notes: Refinement from the WP-LSP-REFS lane gate (2026-07-19): the lsp_references_cell integration test ran end-to-end against a REAL rust-analyzer in lane bpool2 and passed. Small no-proc-macro fixture crates work in lanes; the breakage is specific to workspaces whose target/ holds pod-built Linux proc-macro .so files (the blackbox workspace itself). So the semantic tier is usable in lanes for fixture-scale validation today, and the build-data strategy question (host-platform target dir vs pod-side RA) is scoped to full-workspace RA, not all lane RA.
resolution_note: Addressed by option (a): lane-aware RA spawn env (84171cb8, beta f51f97ec; design section 8.6). Validated firsthand 2026-07-19: unforced path detection fired on /Users/invidious/lanes/bpool4/blackbox (host target dir born at probe launch second), flycheck built 37 host .dylib proc macros into ~/Library/Caches/blackbox/ra-target/<hash>, lsp.hover + lsp.references answered correctly against the lane checkout, RA child reaped on isolate exit (kill_on_drop). Pod-side RA (option b) recorded in 8.6 as the not-built v2.
